objects.trigger page_artifact_empty_page: create trigger page_artifact_empty_page before insert on page_artifacts when not exists ( select 1 from pages where id = new . page_id and owner_user_id is not null and owner_crew_id is null ) or exists ( select 1 from page_panels where page_id = new . page_id ) or exists ( select 1 from page_project_drafts where page_id = new . page_id ) or exists ( select 1 from page_project_live where page_id = new . page_id ) begin select raise ( abort , 'artifact requires an empty human-owned page' ) ; end
objects.trigger page_artifact_human_owner: create trigger page_artifact_human_owner before update of owner_user_id , owner_crew_id on pages when exists ( select 1 from page_artifacts where page_id = new . id ) and ( new . owner_user_id is null or new . owner_crew_id is not null ) begin select raise ( abort , 'artifact owner must be human' ) ; end
objects.trigger page_artifact_no_panels: create trigger page_artifact_no_panels before insert on page_panels when exists ( select 1 from page_artifacts where page_id = new . page_id ) begin select raise ( abort , 'artifact pages cannot contain panels' ) ; end
objects.trigger page_artifact_no_project: create trigger page_artifact_no_project before insert on page_project_drafts when exists ( select 1 from page_artifacts where page_id = new . page_id ) begin select raise ( abort , 'artifact pages cannot contain applications' ) ; end
